history.administration_response: Management considers this recommendation implemented as follows and requests its closure: (a) Management wishes to highlight that the data integrity questions have been clarified as per the above comments in the body of the report; (b) Management is unclear as to what extent Umoja would be able to track costs of certain processes or whether this has been part of the project design. Additionally, we presume that accurate monitoring of end-to-end process costs is quite costly, requiring major changes to the Umoja implementation.
